key_insight: Latent-conditioned parameterized quantum circuits (LPQCs) are proven to be universal approximators for quantum state distributions.
engineering_relevance: LPQCs offer a novel approach to generative modeling in quantum systems, enhancing applications in quantum simulation and chemistry.
method: Utilizes classical neural networks for mapping latent variables to quantum circuit parameters.
Introduces multimodal latent priors and mixture-of-experts architectures.
Proves LPQCs can approximate probability measures over quantum states.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments demonstrate LPQCs outperformed quantum generative baselines while being competitive with classical methods.
watch_item: Requires careful tuning and may face challenges with optimization in certain configurations.
paper_title: Latent-Conditioned Parameterized Quantum Circuits as Universal Approximators for Distributions over Quantum States
